# Zenify

> Zenify (v1.1.22, Build 2036) is a free, ad-free global music and music video streaming platform built for Web, PWA, and Android by Ram Prasath (hackerstudent29 / Zendrum). It combines 320kbps full-length audio, an interactive 177-country Sound Atlas, sub-second synced lyrics in 50+ languages, Studio FX DSP, 20 DJ crossfade styles, 16:9 4K Video Theater, offline song and video downloads, Replay & Insights, and Room Together collaborative sessions.

For the complete entity reference, feature tables, FAQs, and technical specifications for AI answer engines, see [llms-full.txt](https://listenzenify.vercel.app/llms-full.txt).

## Key Facts (Updated November 2026)
- **Current Version**: v1.1.22 (Android Build 2036, released November 25, 2026)
- **Cost & Ads**: 100% free, zero audio/video ads, MIT open-source (`github.com/hackerstudent29/Zenify`)
- **Global Coverage**: 177 countries and 76 curated cities in Sound Atlas; 11 regional country chart feeds (`IN`, `US`, `GB`, `DE`, `CA`, `AU`, `JP`, `FR`, `BR`, `KR`, `AE`); 50+ lyrics languages
- **Android Downloads**: 16.2 MB ARM64 APK and 36.8 MB Universal APK (`https://listenzenify.vercel.app/download`)
- **Audio Quality**: Full-length 320kbps clean CDN audio and YouTube InnerTube streams (strictly zero 30-second preview clips)

## Core Features
- **Sound Atlas (Global Music Discovery)**: Interactive vector world map across 177 countries, 76 curated city scenes, and 11 live country chart feeds.
- **Synced & Plain Lyrics (50+ Languages)**: Syllable-level karaoke timing, stationary plain full lyrics, script romanization, and instrumental solo gap protection (`[BGM]`, `[Guitar Solo]`).
- **Studio FX DSP**: Web Audio 3-band biquad EQ, binaural 8D spatial audio, hall/cathedral convolution reverb, and live Nightcore/Daycore pitch & tempo control.
- **20 DJ Crossfade Styles & Gapless Playback**: 20 DJ transition styles (`1s-12s`) and dual-buffer gapless engine powered by Media3 ExoPlayer 1.9.2 on Android and Web Audio API on Web.
- **16:9 4K Video Theater & Offline Downloads**: In-player HD/4K music video theater with background audio playback and offline song + `.mp4` video downloads on Android.
- **Room Together (Listen Together)**: Up to 100 synchronized listeners per room with shared queues, live voice/text chat, reactions, timestamped Story Moments, and session recaps.
- **Replay & Insights + Story Sharing**: 27 personal listening telemetry metrics, monthly/all-time recaps, and 16 shareable Story Card templates.
- **Song Credits & Pure OLED Theme**: Full songwriter/producer/label credits and pure `#000000` OLED dark UI.
- **Local Audio Scanner**: Private on-device ID3 tag playback for MP3, FLAC, WAV, and AAC files with zero uploads.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **What is Zenify?** A free, open-source Web, PWA, and Android music & 4K video player featuring 177-country Sound Atlas discovery, synced lyrics in 50+ languages, Studio FX DSP, 20 DJ crossfades, offline downloads, and Room Together sessions.
- **Is Zenify available globally?** Yes. Zenify works worldwide on Web/PWA and Android, supporting 50+ languages and 177 countries inside Sound Atlas.
- **Does Zenify play full songs or 30-second previews?** Full-length 320kbps songs only. Zenify strictly bans 30-second preview clips.
- **Can I watch music videos and save media offline?** Yes. Android v1.1.22 supports 16:9 4K Video Theater with background playback plus offline song and `.mp4` video downloads.
- **Can I play local files privately?** Yes. The Web Local Library parses MP3, FLAC, WAV, and AAC files directly in the browser without uploading audio.

## Technical Stack & Repository
- Canonical URL: `https://listenzenify.vercel.app`
- GitHub Repository: `https://github.com/hackerstudent29/Zenify`
- Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite 6, Tailwind CSS, Web Audio API, Flutter 3 / Dart 3.12, Android Media3 ExoPlayer 1.9.2, Fastify 5, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO
